undefinedNew 16:9 civilian Wuhan Yangtze ferry terminal close-up at 7:40am, late-1990s daily life. This must be a dock, NOT a street: left third a worn blue-gray wooden ticket window, little metal ticket punch fixed to counter at x .29 y .66, cream paper tickets on counter, elderly ticket attendant partly visible. Center a long gangway with handrail descending toward a cream and faded red civilian ferry at x .72 y .59. Ordinary commuters in muted cotton clothes and one bicycle pushing onboard, natural poses. Broad river occupies right half, hazy opposite bank and soft wake, thick coiled rope, cleat, rusted bollard, lifebuoy and a tea flask. Dawn sunlight upper left, old paint, paper, river humidity, cinematic depth. Few people, clear physical path for embarking. No tourist cruise or modern luxury marina. No printed text, interface or logos.

undefinedA very wide 3:1 hand-painted panoramic BACKGROUND PLATE for a first-person Wuhan everyday passenger ferry crossing the broad Yangtze at 8am. ONLY RIVER LANDSCAPE, no foreground deck, no railing, no close people. Broad glimmering pale-blue river fills lower 55%, distant opposite riverbank across horizon at y .42, modest old warehouses, laundry on distant houses, tree line, a long steel bridge far left, one small workboat and distant commuter ferry to right. Dawn sunlight, subtle low haze, sophisticated warm/cool textured brushwork, many small ripples and long soft wakes. Strong lateral parallax potential and large continuous water surface. Place main bridge on left 25% and arrival pier buildings on right 25%; no isolated cards/panels, no promotional landmarks. Wide 3:1.

undefinedNew 16:9 Wuhan old-neighborhood OUTDOOR CINEMA courtyard at night, not a food stall. Natural amphitheater of gray-brick courtyard, laundry overhead, climbing vines, tiled roofs. A large clean blank warm-white cloth movie screen at center-left EXACT rectangle approximately x .24-.69 y .24-.63 of frame, tied to bamboo poles. Vintage black 16mm projector visible at lower-right x .79 y .70 with two metal reels and one crank, simple warm lightbulb nearby. Five naturally posed Chinese neighbors and children seated in low stools mostly foreground left and bottom, backs/side profiles watching blank screen. A grandmother with fan, barefoot boy by enamel teacup, thermos and sunflower seed bowl. Warm amber projector beam through dust, midnight navy shadow, quiet intimacy. Screen stays plain white/cream without any copyrighted movie. No brand/logos or lettering. Precise hand-painted cohesive texture. Keep enough empty dark area lower center for physical controls.

Broad navy water occupies whole middle and right 70% of image; gentle amber reflections from ordinary distant apartment windows, opposite bank no tourist neon. Foreground left an older Chinese man naturally seated low on stone river steps, navy cotton jacket, faded cap, small enamel tea mug, bamboo bait box, bucket. His long thin fishing rod angles up from x .31 y .75 to .60 .33, line falls toward tiny pale fishing float at x .66 y .67. Massive stone steps, wet moss, rope, willow branches upper-left, bicycle in deep left background. Night breeze, moon haze, reeds at bottom-right, very clear intimate fishing spot. No fish trophy, no game interface, no crowded stalls. Leave visual focus on rippling water and luminous float. Hand-painted detailed cinematic scene.
